assentPoints: You may receive invitations to surveys that are suitable for your age.
You can choose whether to take part in each survey.
You can skip questions where the survey allows it or stop taking part.
You do not have to buy anything to participate.
Your answers will be handled as explained in the privacy information.
Some surveys may need extra permission before you can take part.

selections.title: Contact and verification

selections.title: Additional study contact

selections.title: Recording or identifiable material
selections.text: I understand that audio, video, photographs or identifiable quotations require separate study-specific information and any additional permission required by law. Selecting this option does not provide blanket permission for all future recordings or publications.

selections.title: Sensitive research
selections.text: I understand that surveys involving sensitive information may require a separate explanation, risk review and additional permission. This option does not authorise all future sensitive-data collection.
